en.why_it_matters: Hamasyan is almost a perfect Listening Notes case: a pianist whose language fuses improvisation, Armenian modal traditions, progressive-rock architecture and a highly percussive instrumental identity. A one-night first appearance at Billboard Live Tokyo concentrates that language into a club-scale setting rather than a routine multi-city stop.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect the night if in Tokyo; this is worth crossing the metro area for and could anchor a short Tokyo music itinerary, though it does not alone justify a transpacific trip.

es.why_it_matters: Hamasyan es casi un caso perfecto para Listening Notes: un pianista cuyo lenguaje mezcla improvisación, modos armenios, arquitectura de rock progresivo y una identidad instrumental muy percusiva. Que sea su primera aparición en Billboard Live Tokyo, en una sola noche y a escala de club, vuelve la fecha mucho más específica que una parada rutinaria de gira.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Hay que proteger la noche si estás en Tokio; vale cruzar el área metropolitana y puede anclar un pequeño itinerario musical, aunque por sí sola no justifica cruzar el Pacífico.

His work also sits directly at the jazz/hip-hop/cross-genre seam that Listening Notes tracks, making the engagement more than a generic international jazz booking.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Worth building a Tokyo night around, especially for the contrast between Washington's expansive music and a club-scale room; strong regional priority, not a stand-alone transpacific trip.
